title.value: Build a minigame collection in a day

introduction.value: A data professional drafted a prompt with ChatGPT and used Cursor agent mode to build a Python tkinter game with four minigames.

method.value: Alvin Leung, a data scientist, spent a few minutes with ChatGPT refining a game concept into a short prompt: four minigames, Python with tkinter, time-based scoring. In Cursor he first had a simple scene-based architecture set up. He then described each minigame in plain language to agent mode, which generated the logic, UI, input handling and scoring, and he asked for follow-up tweaks. He tuned difficulty himself.

outcome.value: He had a playable game in a couple of hours. It had four minigames, JSON-saved high scores and a leaderboard, and BCG-green theming. Feedback came from three colleagues, so the evidence is thin.

notes.value: He did the game design himself and tuned balance, such as enemy and block counts, by hand without the AI.

source_text.body:
Build a minigame collection in a day
A data professional drafted a prompt with ChatGPT and used Cursor agent mode to build a Python tkinter game with four minigames.
Done with
CR
Cursor
GA
ChatGPT Agent
What they did
Alvin Leung, a data scientist, spent a few minutes with ChatGPT refining a game concept into a short prompt: four minigames, Python with tkinter, time-based scoring. In Cursor he first had a simple scene-based architecture set up. He then described each minigame in plain language to agent mode, which generated the logic, UI, input handling and scoring, and he asked for follow-up tweaks. He tuned difficulty himself.
How it went
He had a playable game in a couple of hours. It had four minigames, JSON-saved high scores and a leaderboard, and BCG-green theming. Feedback came from three colleagues, so the evidence is thin.
Worth knowing
He did the game design himself and tuned balance, such as enemy and block counts, by hand without the AI.
Try it yourself
with
Cursor
Copy prompt
Help me build a simple desktop game collection in Python using tkinter, with [number] minigames like [examples: snake, pong, memory match]. Build, run, and debug each minigame until it works end to end, then show me the finished app.
Original source: https://medium.com/@leung.alvin/how-i-built-a-complete-game-in-one-day-using-chatgpt-and-agent-mode-in-cursor-1c39b336134b
